name: Bjorn Larsson
bio:
Bjorn Larsson's career in motorsport began almost by accident. Originally trained as a mechanical engineer, he found himself drawn to the fast-paced world of rally racing after a chance encounter with a local team needing technical expertise. He quickly proved adept at problem-solving under pressure, and his meticulous nature made him an invaluable asset.

He transitioned to circuit racing after a decade, rising through the ranks to oversee operations for several successful teams. Bjorn believes in a data-driven approach, constantly analyzing performance metrics to identify areas for improvement. He demands a high level of precision from his team, but his dedication and focus on results have earned him respect throughout the paddock. His reputation is built on a pragmatic approach and getting the best out of limited resources.

At Crown Racing, Bjorn is responsible for ensuring the smooth and efficient running of all team operations, from logistics and scheduling to resource allocation and technical support. He is known for his ability to remain calm and focused, even in the most stressful situations.
